text_en: Think of us in this way, as servants of Christ and stewards of God’s mysteries.
text_cn: 这样说来，人当以我们为基督的服务员和天主奥秘的管理人。

text_en: Moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found trustworthy.
text_cn: 说到管理人，另外要求于他的，就是要他表现忠信。

text_en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you or by any human court. I do not even judge myself.
text_cn: 至于我，或受你们的审断，或受人间法庭的审断，为我都是极小的事，就连我自己也不审断自己，

text_en: I am not aware of anything against myself, but I am not thereby acquitted. It is the Lord who judges me.
text_cn: 因为我虽然自觉良心无愧，但我决不因此就自断为义人；那审断我的只是主。

text_en: Therefore do not pronounce judgment before the time, before the Lord comes, who will bring to light the things now hidden in darkness and will disclose the purposes of the heart. Then each one will receive commendation from God.
text_cn: 所以，时候未到，你们什么也不要判断，只等主来，他要揭发暗中的隐情，且要显露人心的计谋：那时，各人才可由天主那里获得称誉。

text_en: I have applied all this to Apollos and myself for your benefit, brothers and sisters, so that you may learn through us the meaning of the saying, “Nothing beyond what is written, ” so that none of you will be puffed up in favor of one against another.
text_cn: 弟兄们，我为了你们的缘故，把这些事贴在我自己和阿颇罗身上，好叫你们跟我们学习“不可越过所记载的”，免得有人自大，高看这个，鄙视那个。

text_en: For who sees anything different in you? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you received it, why do you boast as if it were not a gift?
text_cn: 谁使你异于别人呢？你有什么不是领受的呢？既然是领受的，为什么你还夸耀，好像不是领受的呢？

text_en: Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! Quite apart from us you have become kings! Indeed, I wish that you had become kings, so that we might be kings with you!
text_cn: 你们已经饱满了，已经富足了，已无需我们，自己可为王了；恨不得你们真为了王，好叫我们与你们一同为王！

text_en: For I think that God has exhibited us apostles as last of all, as though sentenced to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, to angels and to mortals.
text_cn: 我以为天主把我们作宗徒的列在最后的一等，好像被判死刑的人，因为我们成了供世界、天使和世人观赏的一场戏剧。

text_en: We are fools for the sake of Christ, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are held in honor, but we in disrepute.
text_cn: 我们为了基督成了愚妄的人，你们在基督内却成了聪明的人；我们软弱，你们却强壮；你们受尊敬，我们受羞辱。

text_en: To the present hour we are hungry and thirsty, we are poorly clothed and beaten and homeless,
text_cn: 直到此时此刻，我们仍是忍饥受渴，衣不蔽体，受人拳打，居无定所，

text_en: and we grow weary from the work of our own hands. When reviled, we bless; when persecuted, we endure;
text_cn: 并且亲手劳碌操作。被人咒骂，我们就祝福；被人迫害，我们就忍受；

text_en: when slandered, we speak kindly. We have become like the rubbish of the world, the dregs of all things, to this very day.
text_cn: 被人诽谤，我们就劝戒；直到现在，我们仍被视为世上的垃圾和人间的废物。

text_en: I am not writing this to make you ashamed, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
text_cn: 我写这些话，并不是为叫你们羞愧，而是为劝告你们，就如同劝告我所亲爱的孩子一样，

text_en: For though you might have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers. Indeed, in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
text_cn: 因为你们纵然在基督内有上万的教师，但为父亲的却不多，因为是我在基督耶稣内藉福音生了你们。

text_en: I appeal to you, then, be imitators of me.
text_cn: 所以我求你们：你们要效法我！

text_en: For this reason I sent you Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, to remind you of my ways in Christ Jesus, as I teach them everywhere in every church.
text_cn: 为了这个缘故，我打发弟茂德到你们那里去，他在主内是我亲爱和忠信的孩子，他要使你们想起我在基督内怎样行事，和我到处在各教会内所教导的。

text_en: But some of you, thinking that I am not coming to you, have become arrogant.
text_cn: 有些人以为我不会到你们那里去，就傲慢自大；

text_en: But I will come to you soon, if the Lord wills, and I will find out not the talk of these arrogant people but their power.
text_cn: 其实，主若愿意，我必很快就要到你们那里去；并且我所要知道的，并不是那些傲慢自大者的言辞，而是他们的能力，

text_en: For the kingdom of God depends not on talk but on power.
text_cn: 因为天主的国并不在于言辞，而是在于德能。

text_en: What would you prefer? Am I to come to you with a stick, or with love in a spirit of gentleness?
text_cn: 你们愿意怎样呢？愿意我带着棍棒到你们那里去呢？还是怀着慈爱和温柔的心情到你们那里去呢？
